# 24_04_2026

## Summary

- Documented the agreed experiment direction: Linux `tc netem` for path shaping, offline `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` preprocessing, and trace-driven replay over Quinn streams.
- Added the first agent behavior rule to the repository instructions.
- Started the media artifact pipeline with planned `data/raw/`, `data/processed/`, and `scripts/media/` layout.

## Notes

- Runtime sender should replay preprocessed media artifacts and semantic manifests rather than hosting a full media stack.
- Large source media belongs in `data/raw/` and should stay out of Git.
- VOD and live should reuse the same source material but apply different replay and usefulness policies.
- Transitioned the packaging direction from HLS-TS bootstrap output toward CMAF-style fragmented MP4 plus a client-facing replay manifest.
- Added replay-mode-aware deadlines plus server-side raw transfer reports so realtime runs can measure lateness and useful delivery directly.
- Refactored the demo binaries into reusable library entry points and added a config-driven harness suite for paired VOD/live runs.
- Extended the harness config with named network scenarios and semantic profiles, and started scoring replay units through `amc-core` in processed AMC analysis outputs.
- Moved harness analysis/config logic out of `main` and switched AMC scoring to prefer semantic hints generated into replay manifests during preprocessing.
- Added a documented replay-semantics note, Linux-only `tc netem` execution hooks in the harness, and Dockerfiles for client/server/harness deployment on a single Linux host.
- Switched the client/server runtime images to distroless while keeping the harness image Debian-based because Linux `tc` support needs a Linux userspace with `iproute2`.
- Switched the default harness image to distroless as well, added an optional `harness-tc` image, and added a compose file for the shared Docker-network workflow on one Linux host.
- Added an explicit Linux VPS runner architecture: host-owned `tc` plus client/server containers for each run, followed by harness `analyze-suite` processing over collected raw reports.
